dct_description_sm: Bar scale on map given in “Scala di Miglia quatro.”
Oriented with north toward upper right of sheet.
Compass rose, shields (including Lion of St. Mark).
Possibly appears in Francesco's Theatro delle Città d'Italia, Padua, 1629.
This copy has pencil inscription in lower left: 159.
